title: Oriental Pearl Tower
visualBrief: Budgeted Oriental Pearl exterior preserves three shafts, three buttresses, all eleven spheres, observation belts and communications mast. Small buttress-joint spheres receive a picture-led correction; original detailed master stays independent.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: +X between the two southern buttress feet
nativeAxes.front: -Z toward the single opposite radial buttress
nativeAxes.origin: Ground level below the circular middle of the mapped tower, not the outer-envelope rectangle center

sourceFacts.reviewScope: Original288124-triangle24940700-byte source reproduced exactly; detailed original recipe preserved. Independent browser derivatives retain the distinguishing exterior with tiered detail.

appearance.identity: Three pale shafts and inclined buttresses with eleven pale/ruby spheres and a segmented communications mast.
appearance.exclusions: Interiors, underground works and neighboring city blocks.

reconstruction.note: Detailed radii, small-sphere locations, support connections, shell panel grids and mast equipment are reconstructed rather than certified as-built values. Published upper-sphere descriptions differ between 14 and 16 m and between observation/sphere-top elevations; the modeled 14 m sphere ends at 349 m under the 350 m mast.

geographicProposal.notes: Inspected skyline and close exterior pictures confirm the three concrete shafts, inclined supports, ruby/pale principal spheres and triangulated shells. The close picture shows three small pale joint spheres partway up the inclined supports; browser derivatives move them from the old entry-foot positions to approximate42m support-joint locations with4.4m radii. Original detailed source remains reproducible. Retain468m height, eleven spheres, authored main sphere heights and the corrected mapped center/alternating shaft-brace phase. Standard viewer PMTiles confirms the tower and plaza context. Off-footprint PMTiles point[-80,0]11.7337m sets approximate ground contact; center34.2199m contains coarse urban imprint. Bounded preview contacts preserve raw samples separately. Exact joint-sphere positions, shell fabrication, hotel pearl layout, shaft connections, maintenance equipment and entrance thresholds remain approximations; wider exhibition complex excluded.
